description: This file is a header (.h) file that declares functions and includes for the autosensing module in a C project. It contains macro definitions, external includes, and function prototypes related to autosensing functionality, intended for use by other source files.

methods.name: is_autosensing_enabled
methods.description: Checks if autosensing is enabled; returns a boolean value.

methods.name: autosensing_found_mode
methods.description: Indicates that an autosensing mode has been found; no parameters.

methods.name: autosensing_init
methods.description: Initializes the autosensing module; returns an integer status code.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_start
methods.description: Starts autosensing with an option to sense current mode; returns status code.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_stop
methods.description: Stops the autosensing process; returns status code.

methods.name: mod_autosensing_notify_intf_changed
methods.description: Notifies that an interface has changed (up/down) and optionally restarts; takes interface name, status, and restart flag.
